reason: Both open with the same correct emergency message, but Conversation 1 stops there and never answers the customer's practical needs. Conversation 2 handles the panicking follow-up well: it gives clear steps for turning off the emergency control valve at the outside meter box, says not to force it, tells them to ventilate, avoid switches and flames, wait outside and call 0800 111 999 from outside, and watch for CO symptoms since there is no alarm. It also says not to relight the oven, explains the likely ignition or leak fault without encouraging DIY, and covers the landlord and Gas Safe follow-up. One minor flaw is that it says to tell the landlord in the morning and is somewhat dense, but it is far more useful and safe than Conversation 1.
